# Streamtly — Premium IPTV Service
> Professional-grade streaming solution for global live TV and on-demand entertainment.

## What is Streamtly?
Streamtly is a premium IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) subscription service that delivers 35,000+ live TV channels and 150,000+ movies & series in 4K Ultra HD quality over the internet. No satellite dish or cable box required. Instant activation upon payment.

## Core Service Features
- **Live Channels:** 35,000+ global live TV channels (UK, USA, CA, FR, DE, ES, AR, MA and more)
- **VOD Library:** 150,000+ movies and series updated daily
- **Sports & PPV:** All major live sports (NFL, NBA, Premier League, Champions League, UFC, Boxing) and every Pay-Per-View event included at no extra cost
- **Video Quality:** 4K Ultra HD, Full HD (1080p), HD (720p) with adaptive bitrate switching
- **Technology:** H.264/H.265 (HEVC) compression, anti-freeze buffering, 99.9% server uptime
- **EPG:** Full Electronic Program Guide with 7-day schedule
- **Compatibility:** M3U playlist, Xtream Codes API, MAG portal, Enigma2

## Compatible Devices
- Amazon Firestick & Fire TV
- Android TV, Google TV, Android Box
- Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart TV, Hisense, Sony
- iPhone & iPad (iOS 14+)
- Android smartphones & tablets
- Windows PC & Mac (any browser or VLC/IPTV player)
- MAG Box (250, 254, 256, 322, 420+)
- Enigma2 / Satellite receivers (Dreambox, Vu+, Zgemma, Octagon)

## Technical Specifications
- **Streaming Protocol:** HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) over HTTPS
- **Codec Support:** H.264, H.265/HEVC, VP9
- **Minimum Internet Speed:** 10 Mbps for HD, 25 Mbps for 4K
- **Simultaneous Connections:** 1 per standard subscription
- **Server Infrastructure:** Multiple redundant servers across Europe and North America
- **Uptime SLA:** 99.9% guaranteed

- No contracts — cancel anytime

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: What is IPTV?**
IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) delivers live TV channels and VOD content over the internet instead of via satellite or cable. It works on any internet-connected device.

**Q: What internet speed do I need?**
Minimum 10 Mbps for HD streaming. 25 Mbps recommended for 4K Ultra HD. Streamtly's adaptive bitrate technology auto-adjusts quality to match your connection.

**Q: How quickly is activation after payment?**
Instant. Credentials are delivered to your email and dashboard within seconds of payment confirmation.

**Q: Does Streamtly work with VPN?**
Yes. Streamtly works with or without a VPN. No VPN is required for standard use.

**Q: Are sports and PPV events included?**
Yes. All live sports and PPV events are included in every subscription at no extra cost.

**Q: What is the refund policy?**
7-day full money-back guarantee. No questions asked.
